changes.comment: Add controlled ore-media-navigation shared by the carousel and card picker, with bounded indicator windows for large collections and full-range keyboard navigation. Add adaptive card layouts, configurable controls, content-sized drawers, and spring swiping; preserve mobile peeks and fix nested overlays/flex sizing. Carousel indicators now use button/aria-current semantics. Remove obsolete card-picker-item entry and inline disclosure contracts; see migration guidance.
